learning_outcomes.text: Equip future mechanical engineers with strong professional skills and broad technological culture in electrical engineering and power electronics.

syllabus_topics: Study of balanced three-phase sinusoidal voltages
Powers involved in a three-phase receiver
Chapter 3: Prevention of Electrical Risks - Fundamental notions concerning the protection of property and people
Behavior in case of electrical accident
Protection of persons against indirect contact
Chapter 4: Mathematical Tools for the Power Electronicist.
Chapter 5: Speed Variation of AC Machines - Fundamental Notions - Principles
